desc: Ideation: foods decompose by vitamin; per-vitamin 1D knapsack over calories; answer = max over c1+c2+c3<=X of min(best1[c1], best2[c2], best3[c3])
Implement input parsing and group foods by vitamin type
Implement numpy-vectorized 0/1 knapsack per group with int64 and NEG sentinel
Convert each dp to "at most c calories" via np.maximum.accumulate
Combine results via per-c1 ternary search + local scan on unimodal min(b2[c2], b3[R-c2])
Verify numpy aliasing safety of dp[c:] = np.maximum(dp[c:], dp[:-c] + a) for 0/1 knapsack
Verify ternary search correctness on unimodal (plateau-prone) function and that the final 4-wide local scan covers the max
Trace sample 1 (expect 3) and sample 2 (expect 0 via NEG -> clamp) through the code
Check edge cases: N=1, all foods same vitamin, X=1, large A_i values (int64 overflow check: max sum 10^9 OK)
